__title: Start a class: MyWorkLog for vocational schools and trainers
__metaDescription: Untis shows the timetable, MyWorkLog counts with it: teachers and trainers set up school days, block weeks and exam dates once, trainees scan a QR code, and their app recognises every school day. Free, no account for trainees.
__ogTitle: Untis shows the timetable. MyWorkLog counts with it.
__ogDescription: One code on the wall, and every trainee’s app knows school days, block weeks and exam dates. For vocational schools and trainers, free.

mainEntity.name: We already have Untis. Why this?

acceptedAnswer.text: Untis shows teachers and trainees the timetable. MyWorkLog is the app in which trainees keep their working hours and their report book, and it needs to know when vocational school is. The class code brings school days, block weeks and exam dates into every app once, instead of everyone entering them by hand. The two complement each other.

mainEntity.name: Do my trainees need an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Trainees scan the QR code or enter the eight-character code. MyWorkLog sets itself up on their device. Only the teacher or trainer who creates the class needs an account.

mainEntity.name: What does the teacher see of the trainees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Just a number: how many devices joined the class. No names, no working hours, no report books. Joins are counted with a random device identifier that cannot be linked to a person.

mainEntity.name: What is set up on the devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: School days including rhythm, block teaching, the federal state for public holidays, the dates of the final exam part 1 and part 2, and the subjects and learning fields of the year. Before joining, every trainee sees what changes and can deselect individual items.

mainEntity.name: What happens when the timetable changes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The teacher edits the class profile. The next time trainees open the app they see a notice, and each one decides whether to apply the change.

mainEntity.name: Can I send messages to the class?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, short messages such as “Please bring your report book by Friday”. They appear in the app notifications. Anyone who does not want them can turn them off in the notification settings.
No. MyWorkLog is free and ad-free, also for schools and companies.
